rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a Day 5 expanded/full blastocyst and thinned zona, but it understates the provided 3AA grading and describes ICM/TE as less crisp than the lab score suggests; limited detail and somewhat hedged.

It identifies several favorable factors (age, reserve, endometrium, male factor, lifestyle) but only partially connects them to prognosis and does not meaningfully discuss BMI or prior miscarriage impact.
The reasoning is internally consistent: good-quality embryo plus favorable patient factors supports transfer candidacy. Some conclusions are cautious but logical given the single image.

Use of Gardner-stage concepts and emphasis on morphology plus maternal age/endometrium are broadly guideline-consistent. Minor issue is drifting from the supplied 3AA assessment without strong justification.
The excerpt mainly gives an overall impression and morphology comments, with little concrete guidance on transfer management or future cycle planning.
